_readme: Examples of the optional per-project config files in .mobile-store-deploy/ at the project root (the pre-rename .flutter-store-deploy/ is still read).
Copy each top-level object below into its own file: .mobile-store-deploy/ios.json, .mobile-store-deploy/android.json and, if used, .mobile-store-deploy/ios-api-key.json.
ios.json holds verbatim ExportOptions.plist keys, deep-merged over templates/ExportOptions.default.plist (project value wins).
For automatic signing, ios.json can be as small as: {"signingStyle": "automatic"}.
android.json: serviceAccountKeyPath enables Phase 1 (Play Developer API); when absent, Phase 2 (Claude in Chrome) is used with the hints below.
android.json: aabPathTemplate is optional; {flavor} is replaced by the flavor name, and the value shown is the default (Flutter's output path).

ios-api-key.json is optional and per machine: an App Store Connect API key for unattended iOS uploads (the environment's ASC_API_KEY_PATH, ASC_API_KEY_ID and ASC_API_ISSUER_ID can replace it). It must be gitignored; the upload script refuses it otherwise.
The rest of this config is safe to commit — the service-account key and the .p8 API key themselves must live OUTSIDE the repo.
